Body.Content:
Azure Database Migration Service is designed to provide a seamless, end-to-end solution for moving on-premises SQL Server, Oracle, and other relational databases to the Azure Data platform. The service supports migration of homogeneous/heterogeneous source-target pairs, and the guided migration process is easy to understand and implement.

Now generally available:

Azure Database Migration Service—support for SQL Server 2005+ to Azure SQL Database Migrations.

The release of Azure supports migrations from SQL Server 2005 and later versions to Azure SQL Database.

Private preview

While the preview release of Azure Database Migration Service will support migrations from SQL Server 2005 and later versions to Azure SQL Database, you can also sign up to participate in the private preview of Azure Database Migration Service functionality supporting migrations from:

  • SQL Server 2005 and later versions to Azure SQL Database Managed Instance or to SQL Server on Azure IaaS Virtual Machines.
  • Oracle to Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Database Managed Instance, or to SQL Server on Azure IaaS Virtual Machines.
  • MySQL to Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Database Managed Instance, or SQL Server on Azure IaaS Virtual Machines.

Learn more.
